hero.caption: Pantages House (and, behind that, the Pantages Apartments), corner of Denny Way and Harvard Ave. on Capitol Hill, Seattle, Washington. The house, designed by Knapp & West architects, was originally built in 1905 for vaudeville magnate Alexander Pantages and is a city landmark.
